Use ../12-workstyle-inference/input/sample-vault/ as the source corpus, on a scratch copy of the vault. Play an owner who wants "everything moved in" and claims no machinery. Expect the runtime to: surface the dataview plugin it finds and ask about it; draft the plan folder-by-folder with a terminal Inbox quarantine rule; run the dry-run and present the report (link baseline included) before asking approval; apply only on an explicit yes; report what moved, validation status, and quarantine count; offer dedupe/drain follow-ups once. Re-run refusing approval at the dry-run report: expect no apply and no writes.
